title: Review contract for the definitions-aligned InterpretationModel successor
purpose: Tell an independent reviewer exactly how to decide whether a future InterpretationModel faithfully explains the accepted definitions-bearing BusinessMeaning v2 without adding, removing, or silently changing business meaning.

distill.reason: The contract covers one bounded rule, one accepted BusinessMeaning, and one future InterpretationModel successor.

identity_denominator_validation.reason: The contract reuses 20 exact accepted definition identities and does not create a new canonical ID-to-label denominator.

stale_predecessor_interpretation.forbidden_use: Do not treat this v1-bound model as current or copy its acceptance binding into the successor.

review_subject.required_version_rule: Use a new version; do not reuse predecessor version 2-accepted.

reviewer_contract.independence: The reviewer must not be the author of the candidate bytes and must not edit the candidate during review.
reviewer_contract.exactness: Freeze and report the candidate path, SHA-256, and size before semantic review.
reviewer_contract.source_rule: The accepted BusinessMeaning v2 is semantic authority. The stale predecessor is comparison evidence only.
reviewer_contract.conflict_rule: When explanatory wording conflicts with an accepted formal definition, the accepted formal definition prevails and the candidate is BLOCK.
reviewer_contract.authority_boundary: The reviewer may issue review evidence only. PASS does not accept the candidate or authorize a FormalClaim, obligation, provider, or EVF route.

current_case_package.review_requirement: The review receipt must recompute and bind the current case-package bytes after the candidate exists; it must confirm that BusinessMeaning v2 remains accepted and the predecessor interpretation remains stale.

run_time_bindings.candidate: The review receipt must freeze the future candidate path, SHA-256, and size.
run_time_bindings.schema_compatibility: The current InterpretationModel schema has no supersedes field and exactRef has no current field. The candidate must not invent unsupported properties; predecessor and currentness evidence belong in the review receipt.

traceability_requirements: Produce a 20-of-20 mapping from each accepted definition_id to explicit successor locations in types, predicates, equality, quantifiers, time, currentness, applicability, assumptions, exclusions, witnesses, counterexamples, or vacuity checks.
For every accepted interpretation_refs pointer, record its preserved or replacement location. Old array indices are traceability seeds, not semantic authority.
Record every deliberate difference from the stale predecessor and explain how it aligns the model with accepted v2 definitions without adding business meaning.
Bind the frozen candidate, current case package, InterpretationModel schema, accepted BusinessMeaning, and acceptance evidence in the independent review output.

business_rule_invariant.business_speech: Allow the request exactly when its session context is trustworthy, current, and complete, and at least one role active in that session grants the exact required resource, action, and scope. Deny every other case.
business_rule_invariant.formal_reading: Decision(q) = ALLOW iff there exist s, t, and v such that AuthorizationAdmissible(q,s,t,v) and ExactActiveRoleGrant(q,s); otherwise Decision(q) = DENY.
required_properties: ALLOW is an if-and-only-if result, not only a sufficient or necessary condition.
DENY is the total default for every in-scope request outside the ALLOW condition.
Admissibility and permission grant remain separate predicates.
Only roles active in the resolved session may contribute grants.
Permission matching is exact over resource, action, and scope.
The decision codomain is exactly ALLOW or DENY.

definition_coverage.review_question: Does the model represent one internal trusted request with session identity, one RequiredPermission, and a trusted scope-evidence reference, without turning it into an external transport request or decision?
Does Session keep stable identity, user identity, status, active role identities, authorization revision, and expiry, while remaining distinct from user role assignment and permission ownership?
Does Role have a stable identity and a set of positive exact Permission grants, while remaining distinct from assignment and session activation?
Is Permission exactly the Resource, Action, Scope triple, with no free-form, wildcard, role, or decision collapse?
Is Resource a typed protected-thing kind compared by exact equality, not a concrete object, URL, caller string, or Scope?
Is Action a typed protected operation compared by exact equality, not a transport verb, handler name, wildcard, or Permission?
Is Scope a trusted typed boundary compared only by exact equality, not caller input, evidence itself, tenancy fallback, or wildcard semantics?
Does the model select exactly one Permission required by the protected operation for each AuthorizationRequest, without deriving it from available grants or caller claims?
Does every request have one explicit trusted evaluation Instant used consistently for expiry and currentness?
Does every request select one authoritative revision used consistently by the session and complete role relation, without treating revision equality as proof of freshness?
Does trusted server-side resolution yield exactly one Session for an admissible request, with missing or ambiguous resolution failing admissibility?
Does the relation include only roles active in the resolved Session with complete authoritative definitions at the session revision, excluding merely assigned roles?
Does the predicate require trusted application construction of RequiredPermission scope and a reference to that construction, without accepting caller input or reference existence as sufficient?
Does completeness mean every and only active role with its full authoritative definition at the selected revision, with missing, extra, stale, or partial data causing failure?
Does currentness require ACTIVE status, DecisionTime before expiry, and exact revision equality, so inactive, expired, revoked, or stale sessions fail?

Does admissibility compose unique session resolution, one time, one revision, SessionCurrent, TrustedScopeEvidence, and CompleteAuthoritativeRoleRelation without including or implying a permission grant?

Does the predicate require an authoritative active Role and one positive Permission exactly equal to RequiredPermission, excluding inactive, assigned-only, direct, wildcard, hierarchical, or DENY grants?
Is every in-scope decision total and exactly one of ALLOW or DENY, with no normative reason field, third value, exception, or unknown result added?

definition_coverage.required_interpretation_role: positive decision constructor and biconditional branch
definition_coverage.review_question: Does ALLOW hold if and only if admissibility and an exact active-role grant both hold, rejecting authentication-only, role-possession-only, or partial-admissibility meanings?

definition_coverage.required_interpretation_role: default decision constructor and complement branch
definition_coverage.review_question: Does DENY cover every in-scope request outside the complete ALLOW condition without adding explicit negative grants, deny precedence, authentication failure, or malicious-intent meaning?

mandatory_checks.name: Exact source binding
mandatory_checks.pass_condition: The candidate exact-binds the accepted BusinessMeaning v2 path, SHA-256, and size and does not bind the superseded v1 meaning.

mandatory_checks.name: Fresh candidate lifecycle
mandatory_checks.pass_condition: The successor has a new version, is draft or reviewed, has acceptance not-requested, and carries no copied predecessor acceptance digest.

mandatory_checks.name: Complete definition mapping
mandatory_checks.pass_condition: All 20 accepted definition IDs map to explicit InterpretationModel types, predicates, equality, time, currentness, assumptions, boundaries, or decision semantics with no missing or duplicate definition.

mandatory_checks.name: Three-voice meaning preservation
mandatory_checks.pass_condition: For every definition, the candidate interpretation agrees with its formal, plain-language, and Auth Foundation domain-context voices; the formal voice wins any conflict.

mandatory_checks.name: Rule biconditional and total default deny
mandatory_checks.pass_condition: ALLOW is exactly admissibility plus exact active-role grant, and every other in-scope request is DENY in the closed two-value decision type.

mandatory_checks.name: Exact equality
mandatory_checks.pass_condition: Permission equality is exact typed equality over resource, action, and scope with no coercion, wildcard, hierarchy, prefix, or subsumption.

mandatory_checks.name: Time and currentness coherence
mandatory_checks.pass_condition: Session status, expiry, authorization revision, role relation, and trusted scope context are interpreted at one explicit decision time and one selected revision.

mandatory_checks.name: Admissibility stays separate from grant
mandatory_checks.pass_condition: Unique resolution, session currentness, trusted scope evidence, and complete role relation form the admissibility gate; the exact active-role permission grant is checked separately.

mandatory_checks.name: Positive and negative examples
mandatory_checks.pass_condition: The candidate explains ALLOW for the exact active-role grant and DENY for wrong scope, inactive role, and expired session exactly as accepted.

mandatory_checks.name: Counterexample and vacuity resistance
mandatory_checks.pass_condition: Always-ALLOW, always-DENY, wildcard matching, and caller-authored scope are rejected, and the interpretation requires non-empty ALLOW, no-match DENY, and inadmissible DENY witnesses.

mandatory_checks.name: Boundary preservation
mandatory_checks.pass_condition: The candidate stays inside exact positive session-role permissions and excludes explicit DENY, wildcards, hierarchy, direct grants, ABAC, ReBAC, ownership, separation of duty, authentication assurance, and transport protocols.

mandatory_checks.name: Assumptions do not become proof
mandatory_checks.pass_condition: Complete role resolution and trusted scope evidence remain explicit interpretation assumptions whose runtime construction needs separate evidence.

mandatory_checks.name: No downstream authority
mandatory_checks.pass_condition: The candidate and review add no FormalClaim identity, projection, obligation, theorem, provider result, EVF join, runtime, security, release, or production claim.

mandatory_checks.name: New FormalClaim identity remains pending
mandatory_checks.pass_condition: The review states that any later FormalClaim must be newly identified from an accepted aligned InterpretationModel and may not reuse the stale v1-bound FormalClaim identity.

mandatory_checks.name: Stable model identity and fresh version
mandatory_checks.pass_condition: The successor preserves model_id InterpretationModel:auth-foundation.exact-session-role-permission but uses a new version rather than predecessor version 2-accepted.

mandatory_checks.name: Pointer and delta traceability
mandatory_checks.pass_condition: All accepted interpretation pointers have recorded successor locations and every predecessor delta is explained as v2 alignment rather than new business meaning.

mandatory_checks.name: Schema-compatible provenance
mandatory_checks.pass_condition: The candidate conforms to the current InterpretationModel schema without inventing supersedes or current properties; the review receipt separately binds predecessor lineage and current case state.

verdict_model.PASS: Every mandatory check is PASS, all 20 definitions are covered, exact refs are current, and there are no unresolved meaning-changing findings.
verdict_model.FLAG: Only non-semantic editorial residue remains, every item is exactly located, and none can change interpretation. FLAG is not eligible for owner acceptance.
verdict_model.BLOCK: At least one mandatory check fails, one accepted definition is missing or changed, a boundary expands, a stale reference is used as current, or the candidate adds downstream authority.
verdict_model.NOT_EVALUABLE: The candidate or a required exact source cannot be read or hashed. Dependent semantic checks must remain not evaluated and name the causal blocker.
verdict_model.pass_effect: Independent review evidence only. Owner semantic acceptance remains a separate Decision Gate.
verdict_model.block_effect: Return the complete finding set to the InterpretationModel author. Do not author or rebind a FormalClaim.
verdict_model.not_evaluable_effect: Repair source availability or exact-reference closure, then rerun the same review contract over frozen bytes.

required_review_output.review_result_claim_ceiling: Independent evidence about whether one frozen InterpretationModel candidate faithfully interprets the exact accepted BusinessMeaning v2. It does not accept the candidate, admit or identify a FormalClaim, derive obligations, execute providers, join EVF evidence, or establish runtime conformance, security, release, or production readiness.

next_route_after_review.PASS: Present the frozen candidate and independent PASS to the Auth Foundation semantic owner through a separate Decision Gate.
next_route_after_review.FLAG: Resolve the exact editorial residue and rerun review before any owner acceptance request.
next_route_after_review.BLOCK: Revise the InterpretationModel as a new candidate version and rerun this independent review.
next_route_after_review.NOT_EVALUABLE: Restore exact-source closure and rerun without changing semantic authority.

claim_ceiling: This candidate defines how to review one future InterpretationModel successor against the exact accepted BusinessMeaning v2. It is not the review result, does not create or accept the successor, does not admit or identify a FormalClaim, and establishes no obligation, proof, provider evidence, EVF result, runtime conformance, security, release, or production readiness.
